description: Product CRUD (Admin) + Image Handling + Admin Dashboard. Depends on FEAT-002 (admin layout, auth, category/subcategory models/routes must exist). Covers ProductImageService, Product Form Requests, ProductController, Product Blade views, Dashboard controller and view, storage:link, placeholder image.
steps: Run php artisan storage:link to create the public/storage → storage/app/public symlink. If it already exists, the command will report it and exit 0.

Add a placeholder image at public/images/placeholder.png — create the public/images/ directory and place a minimal PNG file there (can copy a small real PNG, or create a simple colored rectangle). This is referenced in product views when image is null.

Create app/Services/ProductImageService.php: store(UploadedFile $file): string — generate $filename = Str::uuid().'.'.$file->getClientOriginalExtension(); call Storage::disk('public')->putFileAs('products', $file, $filename); return 'products/'.$filename. delete(?string $path): void — if $path && Storage::disk('public')->exists($path) then Storage::disk('public')->delete($path).

Create app/Http/Requests/Admin/StoreProductRequest.php: authorize true; rules: category_id required|exists:categories,id; subcategory_id required|exists:subcategories,id; withValidator() adds Rule check that Subcategory::find($this->subcategory_id)?->category_id == $this->category_id; name required|string|max:150; slug nullable|string|unique:products,slug; description required|string; image required|image|mimes:jpeg,jpg,png,webp|max:2048; old_price required|numeric|min:0; new_price required|numeric|min:0|lte:old_price; is_active nullable|boolean.

Create app/Http/Requests/Admin/UpdateProductRequest.php: same as Store but: image nullable|image|mimes:jpeg,jpg,png,webp|max:2048 (not required); slug unique ignores current record via ->ignore($this->route('product')).

Create app/Http/Controllers/Admin/ProductController.php: constructor injects ProductImageService. index(Request $request): search by name via LIKE, filter by category_id/subcategory_id/is_active, sort by created_at desc (default) or new_price asc/desc, paginate(15). create(): return view with all categories. store(StoreProductRequest $request): wrap in DB::transaction — call $imageService->store() to get imagePath, call Product::create([...'image'=>$imagePath]), on exception call $imageService->delete($imagePath) and rethrow. edit(Product $product): return view with categories and product's subcategories. update(UpdateProductRequest $request, Product $product): DB::transaction — if new image uploaded, store new image path; $product->update([...new fields...]); if new image stored, delete old image path ($imageService->delete($oldPath)) inside the transaction AFTER update succeeds. destroy(Product $product): DB::transaction — capture $imagePath = $product->image; delete product; $imageService->delete($imagePath). toggleActive(Product $product): flip is_active.

Create resources/views/admin/products/index.blade.php: extends layouts.admin; filter bar (search text input, category select, subcategory select — JS-filtered, status select), table with thumbnail (Storage::disk('public')->url() or placeholder), name, category, subcategory, prices, status badge, actions (edit/delete/toggle); pagination.

Create resources/views/admin/products/create.blade.php: extends layouts.admin; form with category select (on change AJAX fetches subcategories), subcategory select, name, slug (auto-fill on name blur), description textarea, image file input with preview, old_price, new_price, is_active checkbox; @error() messages; @push('scripts') with vanilla JS for AJAX chaining and image preview (FileReader).

Create resources/views/admin/products/edit.blade.php: same as create but pre-filled; show current image thumbnail with label 'Current image — upload a new one to replace it'; image input not required.

Create app/Http/Controllers/Admin/AdminDashboardController.php: index() fetches counts — Category::count(), Subcategory::count(), Product::count(), Product::where('is_active',true)->count(), Product::where('is_active',false)->count(), Category::where('is_active',true)->count() — passes to view('admin.dashboard').

Create resources/views/admin/dashboard.blade.php: extends layouts.admin; stat cards grid (total categories, subcategories, products, active products, inactive products) using Tailwind v4 card styling (white bg, shadow, rounded, padding).

Add Product routes and Dashboard to the admin group in routes/web.php: Route::get('dashboard', [AdminDashboardController::class,'index'])->name('dashboard'); Route::resource('products', ProductController::class); Route::post('products/{product}/toggle-active', [ProductController::class,'toggleActive'])->name('products.toggleActive').
Add use statements for all new controllers to routes/web.php.
acceptance_criteria: public/storage symlink exists (php artisan storage:link exits 0)
POST /admin/products with valid data + image creates product, stores image in storage/app/public/products/, redirects with success
POST /admin/products with new_price > old_price fails validation
POST /admin/products with subcategory belonging to wrong category fails validation
PUT /admin/products/{id} without new image preserves existing image path
DELETE /admin/products/{id} deletes product AND removes image from disk
findings: All FEAT-003 steps implemented successfully. php artisan storage:link exits 0. public/images/placeholder.png created (69-byte minimal PNG). ProductImageService stores via Storage::disk('public')->putFileAs('products', $file, $uuid.ext) and deletes safely with null-check. StoreProductRequest: image required, new_price lte:old_price, withValidator() checks subcategory belongs to selected category. UpdateProductRequest: image nullable, slug unique ignores current product. ProductController wraps store/update/destroy in DB::transaction; old image deleted ONLY after successful DB update; on store failure after image upload, uploaded file is cleaned up. Product index/create/edit Blade views with AJAX subcategory loading, image preview (FileReader), slug auto-fill on name blur. DashboardController enhanced with 6 stat vars (categoryCount, activeCategoryCount, subcategoryCount, productCount, activeProductCount, inactiveProductCount). Dashboard view shows 5 stat cards with colored icons. Routes: 29 admin routes registered. bootstrap/app.php updated with redirectGuestsTo(admin.login) to fix auth middleware redirect. Tests: ProductCrudTest 12/12 pass, AdminDashboardTest 3/3 pass, full suite 17/17 pass. npm run build exits 0 (60.24 kB CSS).
